critique:
**Strength:** The artwork excels in atmospheric world-building by layering hazy CSS gradients, sweeping neon swaths, and canvas-driven rain to create a moody cyberpunk vista, while the bizarre inclusion of scurrying geometric crabs and a guinea pig delivers a brilliant, surreal twist. 

**Area for Improvement:** Relying on external raster assets (`portrait.png`, `guineapig.png`) undermines the generative purity of the piece; procedurally rendering these organic forms via code would make the cyber-nature fusion much more technically impressive and aesthetically cohesive.
